questions.question: What is the difference between labeled break and regular break?
options: Labeled break exits a specific outer loop
Labeled break only works in switch
explanations: Correct. The label lets break exit an outer loop, not just the innermost one. Regular break only exits the loop that contains it.
Labeled break works in any loop.
